title: Gloria's Lemon Brownies (Lemonies)
description: Whether you call them lemon bars, lemon brownies, or "lemonies," you'll be head over heals with these moist lemony treats after just one taste.
ingredients: 0.75 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled to room temperature

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease an 8-inch square baking pan, or line it with parchment paper or nonstick aluminum foil.

Whisk flour, sugar, lemon zest, salt, and baking powder together in a large bowl. Add butter, eggs, lemon juice, and vanilla extract; stir until completely combined. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes. Cool on a wire rack until completely cool, about 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, mix confectioners' sugar, lemon juice, and lemon zest together for glaze in a bowl. Pour glaze over the brownies and leave at room temperature until glaze has hardened, about 20 minutes. Cut into 2-inch squares.
